newsitem.title: COMOROS: Survivors from crashed Ethiopian plane - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Survivors from crashed Ethiopian plane - witnesses.

text.p: Some of the 178 people aboard a hijacked Ethiopian Airlines plane survived when it crashed into the sea just off the Comoro Islands on Saturday, witnesses confirmed.
Earlier, a senior official with the airline had said she believed there were some survivors.
The witnesses said the Boeing 767 broke into two when it plunged into the sea only metres from the shore and next to a beach hotel about 40 km (25 miles) north of Moroni, the Comoran capital.
The witnesses said 10 bodies were quickly recovered.
But there were an unknown number of survivors who were rushed to Moroni and Mitsamiouli hospitals.
